subject: Lighthouse SIG: control walkthrough and artifact roadmap
messages:
From: John Carter <john.carter@lighthousesystems.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Cc: Emily Park <emily.park@lighthousesystems.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: SIG questionnaire + evidence pack and walkthrough

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for taking this. Lighthouse is kicking off a procurement review next week and we need: 
- Completed SIG Core questionnaire (we've attached the CSV export of the questionnaire)
- Control mapping showing where Redwood's controls map to SIG/ISO/SOC2 criteria
- A short set of artifacts (samples) to substantiate critical controls (access reviews, change logs, SOC2 report pages)

Can your team: 1) confirm whether you can supply a control-level mapping by next Wednesday, 2) propose a plan to hand over artifacts (preferred: secure upload), and 3) schedule a 60-minute walkthrough for control owners?

We are particularly interested in the access control, data retention, and incident response controls.

Thanks,
John Carter
Senior Sourcing Manager
Lighthouse Systems

Attachments: Lighthouse_SIG_Request_2027.csv
From: soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: John Carter <john.carter@lighthousesystems.com>
Cc: Emily Park <emily.park@lighthousesystems.com>, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 14 Jul 2027 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: SIG questionnaire + evidence pack and walkthrough

John — thanks for the clear ask. High level plan below; happy to adjust based on your procurement timeline.

1) Control mapping (deliverable): we will provide an Excel that maps Redwood controls to SIG v2.0 sections and to SOC 2 / ISO 27001 references. Target delivery: 2027-07-21 EOD.

2) Artifact exchange: we prefer a one-time secure upload to our portal (secure-redwood-upload.redwood.ai). After you confirm, we'll create a tenant-specific upload folder and a short manifest (sample_artifact_manifest.pdf) listing items we will provide. For highly sensitive artifacts we can redact or provide attestations instead.

3) Walkthrough: propose Wed 2027-07-21 10:00–11:00 PT. Agenda: (a) mapping overview, (b) Q&A on access/retention/IR evidence, (c) handoff of upload details and owners.

Owners (initial):
- Neha Kapoor — evidence coordinator + SOC2 liaison (neha_kapoor@redwood.ai)
- Karthik Iyer — infra control SME (karthik_iyer@redwood.ai)
- Marissa Cole — security artifacts and legal redlines (marissa_cole@redwood.ai)

I've attached a draft mapping template (redwood_sig_control_mapping_v1.xlsx) and secure upload instructions. If that schedule works I will send a calendar invite and a protected upload token.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Manager, Security & Trust
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_sig_control_mapping_v1.xlsx; secure_upload_instructions.txt
From: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 14 Jul 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Request: SIG questionnaire + evidence pack and walkthrough

Looping Karthik and Marissa to confirm artifact owners and expected extract timelines. Quick notes from my side: 
- Access reviews: we can provide last two quarterly access review exports (redacted); owner: Karthik.
- Change management: change log for the serving runtime (last 6 months) — API and infra change tickets; owner: Marissa (we may need a legal-approved redaction).
- Incident response: anonymized IR timelines & post-incident reports for non-sensitive incidents; I will collate the table.

Karthik — can you confirm the expected time to extract the access logs and the format? Marissa — can you confirm whether Legal requires an NDA amendment for certain artifacts (we might provide attestations instead).

-Neha
Evidence Coordinator
Redwood Inference
From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 15 Jul 2027 09:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: SIG questionnaire + evidence pack and walkthrough

Neha / Marissa — quick status:
- Access exports: we can produce the access review CSV and the last two quarterly reviewer attestations by 2027-07-20. Format: CSV + signed PDF attestation.
- Logs: for access-related logs we will provide a filtered event set (user-id, action, timestamp, resource) for the requested period. Expect ~2 business days to pull and scrub.
- Change logs: Marissa please confirm if we should include full ticket links or redacted summaries. If redacted summaries are needed, that adds 1 day.

I'll coordinate with InfraOps for the extraction window and provide ETA by EOD Monday.

-Karthik
Senior Infrastructure Engineer
Redwood Inference
From: John Carter <john.carter@lighthousesystems.com>
To: soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Emily Park <emily.park@lighthousesystems.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Jul 2027 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: SIG questionnaire + evidence pack and walkthrough

Soojin — thanks, that plan looks good. Confirming: 2027-07-21 10:00 PT for the walkthrough. Please send the calendar invite and the secure upload token when ready.

We prefer redacted summaries for tickets (no internal links). For logs, CSV is fine; we will treat all artifacts as confidential. I'll share a small procurement intake form (HS-Provision-007) to capture our legal contact and any additional NDA requirements.

See you on the 21st.

Best,
John
Senior Sourcing Manager
Lighthouse Systems

Attachments: HS-Provision-007.pdf (procurement intake)
